rule.title: Not as Described or Defective Merchandise

summary.allegation: The issuer says the cardholder received a Carlton armchair with a structural fault, a wobbling frame and a leg that is not properly seated, that it is not fit for purpose, and that the merchant ignored their refund request.
summary.to_defend: The merchant must show its published description of the item, evidence that what was delivered matched that description and was not defective, and evidence that a return or refund route was offered and not used, or that the cardholder kept using the item after complaining.

requirements.title: Published item description
requirements.text: The merchant's published description of the item the cardholder purchased.
requirements.finding: The product listing snapshot generated from the product page on 15 April 2025, the transaction date, gives the exact item, SKU HH-ARM-CARL-SG, and price of £329.00 matching the disputed amount, with full specifications of frame, legs, seat height and weight limit.

citations.quote: Product: Carlton Mid-Century Armchair, Sage Velvet
Tapered solid oak legs. Seat height 46cm. Maximum recommended user

requirements.title: Delivered item matches description
requirements.text: Evidence the item delivered matches that description (photos, specs, serial number match).
requirements.finding: The delivery photo shows a sage Carlton armchair delivered on 18 April 2025, which matches the listed colour and model, but it is a straight-on front view only with no sides, underside, legs, packaging or serial or order identifier, so it cannot show the frame or leg seating that the cardholder says is faulty.
requirements.gap: No pre-dispatch or quality control images of the frame, legs and underside, no serial or order number tying the photographed chair to txn_6634KL, and nothing rebutting the specific structural fault alleged.

citations.quote: Photo taken by driver at delivery (front view only)

requirements.title: Return route offered and unused
requirements.text: Evidence the merchant offered a return/refund route and the cardholder did not use it, OR evidence the cardholder used and retained the merchandise after raising the complaint.
requirements.finding: Only the generic published returns policy is supplied, which offers free collection and repair, replacement or refund for defective items reported within 7 days; there is no record that this route was communicated to or declined by this cardholder, no correspondence log from returns@havenhome.example, and no evidence the cardholder kept using the chair after complaining.
requirements.gap: No customer service ticket history, email trail or collection record for this order showing a return or refund route was actually offered to the cardholder and not used.

citations.quote: Defective items: please email returns@havenhome.example within 7 days of delivery with photos

alerts.text: The cardholder states the merchant did not respond to their refund request; the file contains only the generic returns policy and no correspondence, ticket or collection record answering that point.
Evidence for R2 was read from an image. Check the highlight.

reasons: Key evidence read from an image
Evidence conflicts with the claim or the transaction data

justification: The description is proven but the condition evidence is a single front view photo and nothing shows the returns route was offered to this cardholder, and both gaps are records the merchant should hold.
rationale:
The cardholder alleges the £329.00 Carlton armchair bought on 15 April 2025 arrived with a wobbling frame and a badly seated leg and that their refund request was ignored.
The listing snapshot dated 15 April 2025 establishes the published description, SKU HH-ARM-CARL-SG at £329.00, so requirement R1 is met.
The only condition evidence is a driver photo of the chair delivered on 18 April 2025 taken front on, which shows colour and model but cannot show the frame or leg seating in dispute.
The returns policy is a policy statement only and does not show that a collection, repair, replacement or refund was actually offered to this cardholder or declined by them.
Representment should be held until the merchant supplies pre-dispatch condition images and the customer contact record for this order.
merchant_requests: Pre-dispatch or quality control photographs of SKU HH-ARM-CARL-SG for this order showing the frame, all four legs and the underside, with order or batch identifier visible
Full customer service record for the order behind txn_6634KL dated 15 April 2025, including all inbound and outbound emails to and from returns@havenhome.example between 18 April and 8 May 2025
Any collection, inspection or engineer report raised after the cardholder reported the defect, or a written statement that no such request was received
Signed delivery note or carrier proof of delivery for 18 April 2025 showing order number, delivery address BS8 1TR and any condition notes taken at handover
Evidence of any refund, replacement or repair offer made to the cardholder and the cardholder's response
